name: Thunderflame
primary:
A burning projectile with an electric blast.
A projectile flies where you look and explodes in a 3-block radius on hit. Effects:
• Damage 1.75 ❤ fire + 1 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 4 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 1 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
